header.title: Two-factor authentication
header.subtitle: Add a second step to signing in with an authenticator app.

status.title: Two-factor authentication is on
status.description: You'll be asked for a second factor when you sign in.

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.description: Regenerating replaces every unused code — old ones stop working immediately.

disable.title: Turn off two-factor authentication
disable.description: Removes your authenticator app and backup codes.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.description: Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or any TOTP app.

titles.regenerate: Confirm it's you to regenerate codes

toasts.verificationFailedDescription: Check your password and code, then try again.

refreshFailed.title: Couldn't refresh your account
refreshFailed.description: Your two-factor authentication status on this page may be out of date — refresh to see the latest.

backupCodesView.description: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in ONE time if you lose access to your authenticator — they will not be shown again.
backupCodesView.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the backup codes. Please select and copy them manually.
backupCodesView.acknowledgeLabel: I've saved these codes somewhere safe.

tooManyAttempts.title: Too many attempts
tooManyAttempts.description: Wait a minute before trying again.

incorrectCode.title: Incorrect code
incorrectCode.description: Check the time on your device and try again.

totpEnroll.instructions: Scan this with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, …), or enter the setup key manually.

mfaPolicy.title: Require two-factor authentication for admins
mfaPolicy.descriptionWithDeadline: Non-enrolled admins are warned until {{deadline}}, then blocked at sign-in until they enroll.
mfaPolicy.descriptionNoDeadline: Admins choose for themselves whether to enable it.

toasts.enabled: Two-factor authentication is now required for admins
toasts.disabled: Two-factor authentication is no longer required
